title: Fixed Ring Tube and Open Canopy Raft
description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed canopied ring-tube raft exterior for dry static display. Two full continuous flattened-bottom oval perimeter tubes surround one recessed solid floor; a thick continuous arched canopy has closed sides and back and a genuinely open front aperture. The canopy lower sides and rear are rooted in the perimeter and floor, not suspended above them. A whole short ribbed front boarding tongue joins the lower ring, and a continuous external grab rope is held by six separate rooted loop keepers. Unlike the old twin-float pedalboat there are no separate pointed hulls, seats, transverse paddle drive or rudder; unlike the cross-pole tent this has a complete annular double-tube perimeter and low floor bay, no diagonal external poles or independent camping base. The whole numeric assembly is newly authored rather than old hulls and a tent imported into a scene. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres Z up, horizontal bounds centred and finite flattened lower tube sole. One prop zero scenes. Fixed empty illustrative appearance only: no inflation, gas chamber, buoyancy, floating, deployment, boarding, capacity, occupancy, weather protection, rescue function, rope tension, manufacture, installation or maritime safety performance. No water, people, emergency markings, rigging, animation or interaction.
